rationale: Adds a View device context menu with five existing commands, permission-aware rows and lazy shared UI Kit presentation. Replaces the previous immediate settings right click without changing persisted configuration or HA APIs.

summary.ru: Контекстное меню устройства в просмотре: настройки, HA more-info, карточка, скрытие и удаление с проверкой прав.
summary.en: View device context menu for settings, HA more-info, device card, hide/show and guarded deletion.

golden.reason: Five shared UI Kit commands on the current View device in dark theme.
Russian light theme retains both information commands and three disabled writer commands.
2.5D View menu at the viewport edge remains fully visible.
Hidden marker temporarily revealed by the eye offers Show on plan in Russian.
